```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
```

```{r}
datos<-read.csv("datos/insurance.csv")
```


```{r}
datos<-datos %>% mutate(sexo_0_1=ifelse(datos$sex=='male', 1,0))

datos<- datos %>% mutate(sexo_factor=as.factor(sexo_0_1))
```


```{r}
función_1<-function(x){
  if(x=='southwest'){0
  } else {
  if(x=='northwest'){1
    
  } else{
  if(x=='northeast'){2
    
  } else{
    3
  }
  } 
  }
}
```


```{r}
region<-datos$region
region<-as.vector(region)
```

```{r}
region_0_3<-lapply(region, función_1)
region_0_3<-unlist(region_0_3)
```

```{r}
region_0_3<-as.vector(region_0_3)
datos<-cbind(datos, region_0_3)
```


```{r}
datos<-datos %>% mutate(smoker_1_0=ifelse(datos$smoker=='yes',1,0))
```



```{r}
datos_1<-datos %>% select(c(age, sexo_0_1, bmi, children, region_0_3, charges, smoker_1_0))
```

```{r}
datos_2<-datos %>%  select(c(age, sex, bmi, children, region, charges, smoker))
```


```{r}
write.csv(datos_1, "datos/seguros_1.csv")
```

```{r}
write.csv(datos_2, "datos/seguros_2.csv")
```
